text:
tom_release: Quick sync — planning v2.56 rollout next Tues/Wed. Need to lock regional windows (US / EU / APAC), cutoff for merges, and branch coordination. Aim: staggered canaries, full traffic in 3 regions within 24h.

kate_eng: Thanks — what's the desired canary order? and any mandatory blackout periods?

raj_sre: Proposal: canary order US -> EU -> APAC. 30m small canary, 2h ramp to 10%, then full. Avoid public infra changes during APAC business hours.

linda_pm: Customer note — avoid APAC morning (UTC+8 00:00-08:00 local). If we do APAC last overnight is best for them.

mike_ops: Branch plan: freeze trunk for release at Fri 17:00 UTC. Create release branch `release/v2.56` at that time. Any PRs after that need cherrypick to release branch.

sara_devex: I'll push a changelog nudge tomorrow morning. Can we confirm any migrations or schema changes?

tom_release: No DB migrations in this release — mostly runtime optimizations + config flag. Good to do canary timestamps: US canary 2026-03-30T01:00Z, EU canary 2026-03-30T05:00Z, APAC canary 2026-03-30T13:00Z (approx).

raj_sre: Add monitoring checklist: perf dashboards, error budget, alert thresholds. Runbook: https://confluence.redwood/release-runbook 
- pre-canary smoke tests
- live traffic sampling (1%)
- auto-rollback if 5xx > 0.5% over 5m

mike_ops: Quick commands for release branch:
```
git checkout -b release/v2.56
git push origin release/v2.56
gh pr create --title "release: v2.56" --base main --head release/v2.56
```
Also tag: `v2.56-rc1` after CI passes.

deploy-bot: scheduled: canary us-west-2 at 2026-03-30T01:00:00Z; pipeline queued.

kate_eng: For changelog, please include the perf bullet and the new `cache-prefix` flag. I'll draft release notes.

sara_devex: I'll send internal announcement + docs nudge once branch is cut. Who wants the pager for first 2h canary?

raj_sre: I'll take first canary, tom_release takes EU, mike_ops covers APAC ramp. Add on-call rotation to the thread.

tom_release: Great — final checklist:
- Fri 17:00 UTC: freeze + branch cut
- Sat/Sun: final smoke + staging validations
- Mon 09:00 UTC: dry-run (deploy to staging regions)
- Tue 01:00 UTC: US canary start
Set reminders and tag in release channel day-before. :thumbsup:

mike_ops: Noted. I'll open the release PR and add the deploy pipeline variables for stagger windows.

sara_devex: I'll ping product + support with the customer-facing window and add a KB article placeholder.

tom_release: Thanks everyone — I'll post an updated checklist after freeze. If anything urgent, reply here or DM.

deploy-bot: pipeline: release/v2.56 build started (CI).
